scope: Actual full original normal/compact/base methods; no method-body extraction or mock planner. Original executor rejects all provider/capability I/O. Inputs vary slice, groups (including duplicates), aggregate flag, existing field/expression orders, facets, descriptor ID and missing/NULL/valid parents. Snapshot covers selected fields, aggregate descriptors, ownership counts, slice/partition/filter presence and ordered field/expression tags. It does not prove full filter serialization or SQL execution parity.
source_invariants: All helper outputs clear facets/relations and retain groups; normal and compact snapshots match. Caller retains input facet/relation ownership.
